text:
Marta: dropping a quick design spike — moving the Pause/Resume control out of the variant chip and into a persistently visible header slot on the rollout timeline. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/rollout-header-proposals Josh: I like the visibility. worried about accidental pauses when people are skimming the header though. can we make it secondary styling? Keiko: agree on accidental clicks. on mobile the header gets crowded. propose a compact icon-only button that expands to label on hover/long-press. Alex (A11y): Accessibility thoughts — screen reader should announce state changes and reason. if a rollout is paused due to automated guardrails we need distinct messaging vs manual pause. SR suggestion: use `aria-live="polite"` for non-blocking updates and also a focused toast for manual actions. Sam: quick perf/impl note — we should avoid full rerender of timeline on pause toggle. just flip state and patch UI. also need optimistic UI until server confirms. Marta: new copy options: 1) "Pause rollout" / "Resume rollout" 2) shorter: "Pause" / "Resume" 3) descriptive: "Pause (stop traffic)". Preference? Josh: prefer 1. explicitness helps reduce mistakes. Keiko: 1 but on mobile use 2 for space, with an accessible label on the button: `aria-label="Pause rollout"`. Alex (A11y): +1 to explicit copy. also recommend announcing the percent when paused: e.g., "Rollout paused at 12% for variant B". It helps keyboard users and voiceover context. Marta: about confirmation — should resume be immediate but pause require confirmation? or both require confirm? my thought: pause = confirm modal (stop path), resume = immediate with tiny toast and undo link. Thoughts? Sam: from infra POV pause is safe to require confirm. resume can be immediate but we should allow canary to ramp automatically if policy permits. keep an undo within 30s. Josh: UI-level: if pause triggers a modal, ensure focus trap and that modal title is clear: "Confirm pause for rollout". keep confirm button destructive style. Alex (A11y): modal checklist: focus on heading, `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, keyboard escape closes, and when modal opens announce via SR: "Confirm pause dialog. This action will stop traffic to variants." Also provide `aria-describedby` to link the longer explanation. Keiko: contrast/colour: current red for Pause is harsh and conflates pause with delete. propose amber/orange for Pause and green for Resume. needs WCAG AA contrast on both dark and light themes. Marta: good call — we'll change Pause to #D97706 (amber 600) and run contrast check. Josh: placement alternatives: A) top-right header (persistent) B) floating action near timeline scrubber C) inside the variant row (current). pros/cons? Sam: A = discoverable but risks accidental. B = contextual but might be missed when paused state needed. C = scoped but not discoverable for multi-variant rollouts. Marta: leaning A with a small safety: make the clickable area small, add a confirmation modal for pause, and add a double-tap safety on mobile (long-press) Alex (A11y): add keyboard shortcut hint for power users (e.g., "p" to pause when focus is within timeline) and expose it in the header tooltip. ensure the shortcut is configurable or documented. Announce shortcut in tooltip text for screen reader users too. Keiko: mobile gesture conflict: long-press on iOS triggers context menu — we should fallback to a tiny overflow menu on long-press in that case. Marta: sample ARIA snippet for the header button we can use as a starting point: ``` ``` Alex (A11y): small tweak: don't put `aria-live` on the control itself. keep live regions separate for status messages. e.g., ```
Rollout running at 12%
``` Marta: thanks — updated. I'll push a Figma variant for header A with modal flow and an alternate compact mobile spec by EOD. deploy-bot: deploy-preview created for `feat/rollout-ui/pause-header` — preview url: https://preview.redwood.dev/rollout-ui/pause-header (expires in 24h) Josh: i'll review the preview and run a quick keyboard/navigation pass. tagging @Alex (A11y) for SR testing when ready. Alex (A11y): happy to test. quick reminder: include a test plan note — how SR reads the toast, modal, and when automated guardrail reason is shown. Keiko: small nit — can we show a subtle badge on the timeline scrubber when paused so folks know the pause point visually? simple dot + tooltip. Marta: love that. adding badge spec. thanks everyone, will iterate and re-upload. :thumbsup:
